user.title: Select ESPHome transmit service
user.description: Pick the ESPHome user service that broadcasts SUNCEN RF bursts (typically named `[device]_transmit_raw`). Set up your ESPHome device in Home Assistant first if no services appear.

remote.title: Add a Sunbell remote
remote.description: Each remote ID (0..12) is a distinct LED-pattern identifier paired with the centralina (0 = all LEDs off, N = only LED N lit). List the channels (1..12) you've installed under that remote.

data.add_another: Add another remote after this one

error.no_transmit_services: No ESPHome user services ending in `_transmit_raw` were found. Add your ESPHome device to Home Assistant first.
error.invalid_channels: Invalid channel list. Use comma-separated integers between 1 and 12.
error.duplicate_remote: That remote ID is already configured.
error.no_channels: At least one channel is required.

error.duplicate_remote: That remote ID is already configured.

send_group.name: Send group command
send_group.description: Drive a group of Sunbell blinds with a single Home-Assistant cover command. Pick cover entities (or remote devices) in the target picker — the integration groups them by remote and computes the most efficient SUNCEN burst sequence to reach the requested end state. Raw remote + channels are also accepted.

action.name: Action
action.description: Home-Assistant cover command (Open, Close, Stop, or Set tilt position).

tilt_position.name: Tilt position
tilt_position.description: Target tilt 0..100 (%). Required when action is 'Set tilt position'; ignored otherwise.

remote.name: Remote ID
remote.description: Optional. Raw Sunbell remote (0..12). Required only when not targeting entities/devices.

channels.name: Channels
channels.description: Optional. Channels (1..12) on the remote above. Required only when not targeting entities/devices.
